03bbc313: ;
 ;This routine defines variables used in the Treating Specialty Preference Workload Report.
 ;It allows the user to select sort options and whether to print the report for
 ;inpatients, outpatients, or both.
6d8fce1b: ;If user enters nothing or P/p, use default sort by patient name.
d9e0e62e: ;Translate user input to numerical value for sort order: 1=date, 2=specialty, 3=patient name.

56efb261: ;If user enters invalid sort option, display help text.
7fa0374b: ;If user enters nothing or B/b, use default to print report for both inpatients and outpatients.
